semantic.justification: Task6764KT preserves actual browser physical-face records and available source bytes. FontList groups real registered FontFaces and approved Local Font Access records without discarding actual descriptors, PostScript identity or lazy blob access. Embedded-font installation records the exact constructor bytes by actual FontFace identity in a JS WeakMap and returns independent byte copies. CSS FontFace bytes remain absent because the public FontFace API does not expose its source; CSS URL acquisition,cmap parsing,native face selection and visual preview integration remain unfinished. No glyph support or native font metrics are inferred from names, and no native lifetime machinery is implemented.
